name: Low-Carb Turkey Noodle Casserole
ingredients_verbatim: 1 3/4 oz pork rinds, crushed and ground
why: Well-centered in the band on the source's own printed numbers: 462 cal / 5.5 g total carbs (1.9 g net) / 40.1 g protein per serving - middle of the 400-650 window, far under the 35 g carb ceiling, and outstanding protein density (40 g). Oven-baked at 350F, a true creamy weigh-and-divide casserole that scales cleanly to 14. No seafood. Structurally low-carb (turkey breast + cheeses + cream over shirataki/yam-fiber noodles, no rice/pasta/potato/bread base). Distinct from the catalog: turkey-noodle-casserole uses real egg noodles (high carb) and the accepted turkey-zucchini-noodle-casserole uses zucchini - this uses shirataki 'Wonder Noodles', a different dish. Good pricer-lane specimen: cooked turkey breast maps to turkey-breast and cream-cheese/heavy-cream/parmesan/garlic-powder/onion-powder all sit on the Omaha board, but three signature items have NO board home - the shirataki/yam-fiber Wonder Noodles, gruyere, and pork rinds - deliberately left flagged to exercise the queue.
confidence: high on macros - read directly from the recipe card nutrition block (cal, protein, total and net carbs all printed). Note the noodles/pork-rind/gruyere costs will need new-commodity workflow; cream cheese here is full-fat vs the board's 1-3-fat-cream-cheese row.
